name: District portals (Khulna Division) — bus terminals and airport named on transport pages
notes: No licence stated. No portal publishes a terminal register; rows are names explicitly given on the district 'যোগাযোগ ব্যবস্থা' pages (Jashore airport; Satkhira central bus terminal). Khulna names only ticket counters' areas and train names; Meherpur, Chuadanga, Bagerhat and Jhenaidah list bus companies, timetables and counter numbers but no terminal or station by name (Chuadanga's train table says only 'From Chuadanga'); Kushtia and Jhenaidah name only Jashore airport; Narail and Magura link no transport page. raw/ keeps, per page that gave a row, only the lines carrying the matched phrases (mobiles/e-mails redacted; descriptive text is not copied into the CSVs).
